hints: Start at the state GIS office / geoportal / ArcGIS Hub ('<state> statewide parcels'); the NSGIC/NGDA 'parcels' inventory lists which states have a statewide layer. Known: NC statewide (verified), NYC tax lots, LA County, Harris County, Cook County, Miami-Dade, San Francisco, DC (verified). Colorado has a statewide parcel compilation (Colorado OIT/ 'Colorado Parcels'). Texas has no statewide open layer (county appraisal districts). Request only parcel ID/APN and geometry fields.
